analysis: The trial executed successfully but underperformed: macro validation HR@10 was 0.4188, versus 0.4463 previously (−0.0275) and the stated 0.505 baseline (−0.0862). Category HR@10 was Movies_and_TV 0.480, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.515, Electronics 0.315, and CDs_and_Vinyl 0.365. Previous category scores were not supplied, so category-specific changes cannot be established. This result does not support the hypothesis that this gated prefix-memory addition improves the current model; it does not establish why performance declined. The host reported successful execution, using 1009.19 allocated GPU-seconds.
code_summary: One independently trained SASRec checkpoint per category, with tied item embeddings and jointly learned item bias. A causal cumulative mean of unscaled, padding-masked item embeddings feeds a learned linear projection and tanh. A sigmoid gate computed from concatenated transformer and memory features interpolates between them before final layer normalization. Training retains dense sampled cross-entropy with 99 negatives and per-prefix weighting. Validation selects a single checkpoint by HR@10; the exported predictor reconstructs the same architecture and strictly loads that checkpoint. Code includes causal-prefix, padding, gradient, reload, and predictor-parity checks. No ensembles or separately fitted scoring components are used.
